Role: SPV structuring, cross-border regulatory compliance

Partner_Name: FinDev Gateway / World Bank Financial Inclusion team
Role: Open-access data, sector benchmarking
Why_This_Partner: Use for ongoing literature anchors and market-sizing data for the 90-day gap analysis.

Role: Origination introductions + savings-group standards
Why_This_Partner: Practitioner network and standards body for savings groups, sitting one level above individual VSLA programmes. Two uses in the solo track: introductions to originators running 10-40 branch operations (the EXP-22 screening constraint), and an adoption channel for RT-1 as a published standard, which is edge theory 3. Complements PT-03, which is a methodology network rather than a convening body.

Partner_Name: Coffee cooperative unions and producer federations (anchor market, to be named)
Role: Origination - internal credit fund and member registers
Why_This_Partner: The anchor setting fixed by OQ-16 and M-33 had no tracker row. Cooperative unions run internal credit funds that LIT-031 describes as often informal and unregulated with weak accounting, which is precisely the instrumentation gap the practice sells into. LIT-033 shows member registers are obtainable through the union and the government cooperatives agency and have already been used as a probability sampling frame, so both the origination layer and the verification layer have existing rails. Category row - narrow to named unions once the market is chosen.

Partner_Name: SME and business membership associations (chambers, sector associations)
Geography: To be determined with the market choice
Role: Origination - member lending and guarantee schemes
Why_This_Partner: Named directly in the 2026-09-08 brief as a distribution channel alongside VSLA support organisations, and genuinely distinct from a VSLA network: larger tickets, existing member registers and dues infrastructure, formal governance, but weaker social enforcement of repayment. That difference matters because OQ-12 is unresolved on whether information or social enforcement drives repayment - an association book is a natural contrast case. Category row until the market is chosen.

Role: Origination-side economics; pays incentives on small agricultural loans
Why_This_Partner: Pays lenders origination incentives and portfolio first-loss cover on small agricultural loans, which directly changes whether the originator economics clear at all. Relevant to the two RT-6 drivers still marked ASSUMED - the origination layer's share of the spread, and the fixed cost per deal - because the facility exists precisely on the premise that small agri loans do not cover their origination cost unsubsidised. Also a plausible Lane B mandate source.

Role: Design funding, deal precedent data, investor introductions
Why_This_Partner: Already an evidence source for the venture via LIT-018 on mobilisation ratios. As a partner rather than a source it offers two things the solo track needs: design funding for blended structures at exactly the stage between concept and term sheet, and a deal database that is the closest available comparator set for the guarantee-wrapped facility proposed as deal 1.

Role: Potential lender into the first guaranteed facility
Why_This_Partner: Impact asset manager with an agricultural and cooperative-finance book, so its mandate matches the coffee anchor setting rather than requiring the asset to be explained from scratch. Sits alongside PT-08 as a candidate capital partner, but for a bilateral guaranteed facility rather than a rated tranche - which is the deal-1 structure the RT-5 fixed-cost sweep points to.

Role: Insurance paper and index design for the insurance product line
Why_This_Partner: Fills a partner class that was structurally absent from the tracker. A design practice cannot underwrite, so any insurance half of PL-1 needs a licensed paper provider or a parametric underwriter, and without one the insurance product line is undeliverable regardless of design quality. Directly relevant to EXP-10, which proposes an index calibrated to leaf rust and heat stress rather than rainfall alone.

Role: Technical assistance funding, microinsurance product standards
Why_This_Partner: Funds and documents inclusive-insurance product development, which is the shape of the Lane B design mandate the solo model depends on for early revenue. Also a standards ally for the verification leg. Note the standalone impactinsurance.org domain no longer resolves to the Facility - use the ILO-hosted page.

Role: Sector data, product standards, practitioner convening
Why_This_Partner: Publishes the sector landscape data for inclusive insurance and convenes the practitioners who would have to adopt any origination standard covering premiums and claims. Adoption channel for the insurance half of RT-1, in the same role SEEP (PT-11) plays for the savings-group half.

Role: Administrative-data research partnership; embedded evaluation
Why_This_Partner: Runs administrative-data partnerships with financial institutions as standard practice, which is the exact shape of the EXP-25 collaboration - the practice brokers pseudonymised loan-level access, the institution brings econometrics, ethics approval and publication. Supplies the principal-investigator eligibility and IRB approval that OQ-21 identifies as not replaceable by a solo company.

Partner_Name: CEGA (Center for Effective Global Action, UC Berkeley)
Role: Administrative-data research partnership; measurement methods
Why_This_Partner: Development-economics research centre with a strong administrative-data and measurement-methods track, and an affiliate network that makes a practitioner affiliation (OQ-21 Form 3) plausible without enrolment. Approach in parallel with PT-20 and PT-05 rather than sequentially - the MOU takes months and gates nothing else.

Role: Fast small research grants on live policy-relevant work
Why_This_Partner: The most solo-compatible entry point in the research-funding class: small, fast-turnaround grants run through country offices, explicitly for policy-relevant work with local partners, and not requiring the applicant to be a tenured principal investigator in the way a large trial grant does. Route for OQ-21 Form 2 - an embedded evaluation running alongside a real facility with the academic partner as PI. Logged as a funder at FUND-11.

Role: Large-scale impact evaluation; open publication of methods and data
Why_This_Partner: Runs impact evaluations at scale with government and financial-sector counterparts and publishes methods and data openly, which matches this repo's own open-by-default posture. Slower and more institutional than PT-20 or PT-22, so treat as a second-wave approach once EXP-25 has a data source rather than a first-wave one.
